target.title: fix(model-catalog): keep profile-specific model rows distinct
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When multiple auth profiles expose the same provider/model id, the model catalog and picker collapse those rows into one option. For example, two OpenAI profiles that both expose `openai/gpt-5.5` become indistinguishable, so users cannot select the intended account/profile from the picker.

This PR keeps profile-specific rows distinct by including `profileId` in catalog and picker keys, while preserving existing provider/model behavior when no profile is attached.

## Summary

- Carry optional `profileId` on model catalog entries.
- Include `profileId` in catalog merge/dedupe keys.
- Include `profileId` in picker option keys and show profile hints.

## Evidence

Server worktree: `/tmp/gpt55-picker-clean-pr`.

- `verify-fix.mjs` PASS: old behavior collapses two `openai/gpt-5.5` rows to one unique key; new behavior keeps distinct keys:
  - `openai/gpt-5.5@openai:zilokki@gmail.com`
  - `openai/gpt-5.5@openai:owndate1`
- `oxfmt --check src/agents/model-catalog.ts src/agents/model-catalog.types.ts src/flows/model-picker.ts` PASS.
- `git diff --cached --check` PASS before clean commit.
- PR diff is scoped to 3 source files: `src/agents/model-catalog.ts`, `src/agents/model-catalog.types.ts`, `src/flows/model-picker.ts`.

## Safety

- Replacement for #106338 because upstream main introduced workflow changes that the available PAT cannot fast-forward into the old branch without `workflow` scope.
- No force push.
- No main push.
- No live config/restart/auth changes.
